reconstruction.basis: Level62.28m plane near LiDAR path median62.245m. Original4.4m above-moat estimate replaced by6m; original roof/window dimensions remain photographic estimates. Gloriette level is reconstructed with adjoining building, not measured from DTM under removed buildings.
reconstruction.fixtureEdits: Sparse4m nearest-neighbour review grid from1m public DTM. The convex architectural/island ground cutout is reproduced by sinking its terrain below the lake, with6m grid padding to prevent bilinear edge intrusion. Flat lake cells lowered0.35m. Unedited native terrain heights remain in heightsMeters.

limitations: 2022 composite DTM, not current water survey or bathymetry. Flat56.28m lake cells are the dataset surface control. Building removal gives implausible low Gloriette court; do not use it as measured architectural floor. Uniform current floor, arches and heights remain reconstruction. Local pyproj fallback transform has2m nominal horizontal accuracy; shoreline1m pixels and source4m fixture are not a survey. Matching ODN host terrain/water required.
